updates.sentence: Held at Hinds County Jail after the July 24, 1961 airport Freedom Ride; the four-person group spent three days in jail before bail. Exact release day remains unverified.

updates.sentence: Sentenced July 31, 1961 to four months and a $200 fine after the July 30 Freedom Ride arrest. Held initially in Jackson, then at Parchman, where he reported serving 39 days. Exact release date and total including initial local detention remain unverified.

entries.rationale: MDAH collection history explicitly dates arrest July 30 and trial the next day. Posner confirms 39 days at Parchman; Jackson State finding aid separately mentions initial local detention, so 39 is not asserted as complete total. Its July 29 arrest conflicts with MDAH and the existing booking date, which are retained.
